QuestInfo.name: Word from the Hideout
QuestInfo.0: #b#p438##k has something else to tell me.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p438##k overheard the #b#p411##k's men planning a raid on the Hollow. I should confront the #b#p411##k in the #b#m010003003##k.
QuestInfo.2: The #b#p411##k admitted his men plan to raid the Hollow. He also told me who tipped him off: #b#p437##k.

0.0: There's something else. I should have told you sooner.
0.1: Yesterday I heard the #b#p411##k's men talking. They know about the Hollow now, and they're planning a raid. Not a few scrolls. Everything.
0.2: The fairies can't fight off the whole guild. Someone has to talk to the #b#p411##k before it starts.
0.3: He'd never listen to me. But he might listen to you.

yes.0: He's in the #b#m010003003##k. Be careful. He doesn't like surprises.

no.0: Then I hope the fairies are ready. Because I'm not.

1.0: You walk into my hideout without asking? Bold. State your business.
1.1: ...The Hollow. So word has spread. Yes, my men will go. Fairy treasure is too good to leave to the fairies.
1.2: Who told me? A fence named #b#p437##k. He brought me the tip himself, hoping I'd let him into my inner circle.
1.3: Ambition is useful. Loyalty is better. Go and see what kind of man he is.

npc.0: The #b#p411##k is in the #b#m010003003##k. Someone has to stop the raid.
